decisions.reason: Operator training costs little to keep, supports the core machine business, and had its own page for two years, so there is no evidence that its value has failed to materialize.
A fourth rotary axis is a low-cost modular add-on that extends the core milling machines, so keeping this option open is cheap even though it was only mentioned on the website.

Hybrid additive post-processing is far from the core business and was only mentioned once, but it fits the firm's strategic push into additive and digital workflows, and its uncertainty is still unresolved, so a cheap option is worth holding a little longer.
The high-speed CNC milling machine is close to the core business and had its own page, making it a central product rather than a marginal option to abandon.
The automatic tool change system builds on the core machines, had its own page, and adds productivity value at low incremental cost.
